reason: I'd rather pay the crew directly and avoid the middleman. A platform that takes a cut on top of the builder's bid is one more cost I'd have to justify, and I'm not convinced the contract and payment handling are worth it.
objection: Whether the platform's bids end up cheaper than going to the crew myself, or whether I'm just paying extra for a contract I could have drawn up or a builder I could have found through a friend.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real builder bids on the same brief that come in at or below what I'd pay going direct, with a fixed, clearly stated fee and proof the payment is held until the work is signed off.
